notes: Pass if the continuous S11<=-10 dB band covering 77 GHz (nearest sweep point) has relative bandwidth 2(fH-fL)/(fH+fL) >= 0.30. Do not pass/fail on matching S11_min. Nominal must pass (~32% around 77 GHz, only ~2pp of headroom); sandbox start must fail (no -10 dB band). Budget is 24 hours of HFSS solve time only (sum of log solve_time lines); protocol.on_time is separate from RF pass. Third sitting: RF floor stays 0.30; budget 8h -> 24h after the second sitting matched 77 GHz but stopped at 26.4% / 8h07m.
